**Both r18 findings are closed at `3de576e93ca1d41604cdd5f3dba167598273ab05`.** I found no additional concrete, reachable defect introduced by these repairs within the requested scope. The seven reviewed code/test files match the supplied child commit.

1. **Immutable late-refusal partial commit — closed.** The [candidate transaction](/Z:/Projects/T3-worktrees/oku_flow/t3-209bf833/src/common/ultra_clear_text.cpp:3016) restores retained words, reading retirements, colors, masks and classification, counters, footprints, carrier, IDs and row index on refusal. Cross-owner carving completes inside that transaction. Both the late operator-risk failure and the 8,191-slot append/fragment failure therefore undo the earlier append. Provisional incoming IDs are restored before merging; independent contradiction blocks retain their existing authority.

2. **Narrow raster withdrawal — closed.** The [regional precommit check](/Z:/Projects/T3-worktrees/oku_flow/t3-209bf833/src/common/ultra_clear_text.cpp:3812) detects novel or strengthened protection and includes retained outside-line glyphs. The controller supplies the proposed scene to [PreservesDrawnWords](/Z:/Projects/T3-worktrees/oku_flow/t3-209bf833/src/ui/ultra_clear_text_overlay.cpp:735), which compares actual old drawn identities against one production scratch plan. The thin original mask keeps its conservative pixel coverage; admission is refused when that coverage suppresses an existing word. Scratch content, glyph layout and protection are restored on every guarded exit, while the published plan and tickets remain untouched. Model IDs, pending evidence and accepted lines commit only after success. Full reads and independent probes retain correction authority.

The fixtures exercise policy, rather than merely accepting universal refusal:

- The archived baseline logs contain the two expected immutable failures and two raster-admission failures; both raster rows first establish an actually drawn old word.
- The [scratch-plan fixture](/Z:/Projects/T3-worktrees/oku_flow/t3-209bf833/tests/ultra_clear_text_tests.cpp:3497) requires success with a safe distant mask and refusal with the offending thin mask. It also checks budget, cold-text and changed-view refusal without altering paint state.
- The controller timing fixture successfully admits safe regional mask changes, covering the callback integration. Existing immutable fixtures still require successful appending/deduplication with protection preserved. The new refusal fixtures check retained state and subsequent ID allocation.

I inspected the archived **SCOPED CPU/PCH-off 4/226 pass**, including the relevant positive and negative rows; I did not rerun it. The seven-file comparison ties that reviewed implementation to the frozen root.

Performance reasoning supports finite metadata bounds, one candidate snapshot at a time, cached typography and cooperative deadline checks. It does **not** establish a hard 3 ms bound: allocations, sorting and individual Qt region operations are not preemptible.

Combined-root shipping/PCH-on/CPU/CUDA validation and native acceptance remain outside this closure. BF16 quality, 704 sampling tradeoffs, separate book-fit work and the RAM recap were not reopened. This review used read-only Git/file inspection; no modifications, agents, builds, tests, models, apps, settings changes or PR monitoring.
